teaching_goal: The promoter is where RNA polymerase starts, and it sets which way the gene is read.

review_notes.hook_claim: L21-p1: the promoter is where RNA polymerase makes initial contact to start transcription; it also determines the direction of reading.
review_notes.analogy: A start line that also shows which way to run.

scenes.title: Where does transcription start?
scenes.narration: Where does RNA polymerase start reading? Not just anywhere. It starts at the promoter. The promoter is a stretch of the gene that marks the start. RNA polymerase makes first contact right here. The promoter also sets the direction. So reading goes this way. Like a start line that also shows which way to run. The promoter is where RNA polymerase starts, and it sets which way the gene is read. Swipe.
